question: Should Featherless be accepted as an official external provider package for this release after the package-boundary, docs-map, and changelog blockers are fixed?
rationale: The code path is additive and aligned with the plugin boundary, but making a new official provider package creates public auth, install, package, and release surfaces that need maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept after launch blockers are fixed
options.body: Proceed with the official external provider once the declaration export, generated docs map, release-owned changelog edit, and package publish timing are resolved.

options.title: Defer provider publication
options.body: Keep the issue open and hold the PR until maintainers are ready to reserve and publish the official package.

options.title: Keep Featherless as custom config only
options.body: Close the PR directionally and rely on generic custom-provider setup rather than adding a first-class official package.

recommendation.title: Accept after launch blockers are fixed
recommendation.body: Proceed with the official external provider once the declaration export, generated docs map, release-owned changelog edit, and package publish timing are resolved.
